CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   B. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   D. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.

4. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)

7. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   D. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   C. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)

11. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)

   B. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.

12. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   B. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

14. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   B. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
